lines.trans: Every single day my emotions rise and fall right along with you.
When you are happy I am happy, and when you are unhappy I am unhappy too.
If a day goes by without seeing you, I feel practically sick.
When you are so extraordinary, what am I supposed to do?
On the day of the storm broadcast I could not hold back anymore, because I truly like you so much!
Pick up your things.
I realise now I had everything wrong before.
I should stop lying to myself—I really do like you!
Go on—take your things and leave my home!
Thank you for looking after me; I will head out now.
